segments.content: WLOG sort a₁ < a₂ < ... < aₙ (by applying a permutation)——对跳跃长度排序，将一般情形归约为排序情形
Let x = a₁ + ... + a_{n-1} (sum of all but the largest element)——定义关键变量x为除去最大元后的前n-1个元素之和
We proceed by strong induction on n——声明对n做强归纳的证明策略
Three cases based on the position of M's elements relative to x——根据M中元素相对于x的位置关系分三种情况
Case 1条件: x ∈ M and ∃ y ∈ M with y > x——Case1的前提条件：x在M中且M中有元素大于x
Then n ≥ 3——由Case1条件推导出规模下界n≥3
Among the n-1 small elements, define 'bad' index i if x - aᵢ ∈ M or s - aᵢ ∈ M——定义坏索引：使得x-aᵢ或s-aᵢ落入M的索引
The map from bad indices to M\{x} is injective (x - aᵢ maps to M\{x} since x ∈ M and aᵢ > 0; s - aᵢ > x so maps to M∩(x,∞))——证明坏索引到M\{x}的单射映射
Since |M\{x}| = n-2, there are at most n-2 bad indices among n-1 total, so at least one good index r exists with x - aᵣ ∉ M and s - aᵣ ∉ M——鸽巢论证得出好索引r的存在性
Let t = x - aᵣ, M' = M ∩ (-∞, t]——定义截断参数t和缩减禁集M'
Then |M'| ≤ n-3 (since both x and y are excluded from M')——推导M'的规模上界
Apply induction to the n-2 remaining elements (excluding aᵣ and aₙ) with M', getting permutation p'——对缩减后的问题应用归纳假设
Construct the full permutation: place p' first, then aᵣ, then aₙ (with a swap to put aₙ second-to-last)——构造完整排列，使用swap技巧放置aₙ
All prefix sums before aᵣ are ≤ t and avoid M'——验证aᵣ之前的前缀和避开M'
the sum up to aᵣ is s - aₙ = s - aᵣ - (sum of rest) which avoids M by choice of r——验证到达aᵣ时的前缀和避开M（利用好索引r的性质）
the final sum is s ∉ M——验证最终前缀和（总和s）不在M中
Case 2条件: x ∉ M and ∃ y ∈ M with y > x——Case2的前提条件：x不在M中且M中有元素大于x
Then |M ∩ (-∞, x]| ≤ n-2——推导M在(-∞,x]部分的规模上界
Let M' = M ∩ (-∞, x]——定义缩减禁集M'为M在x以下的部分
Apply induction to a₁,...,a_{n-1} with M' (sum = x ∉ M')——对前n-1个元素和M'应用归纳假设
If M' is empty, use identity——M'为空集时的边界情况处理
Otherwise get permutation p', extend by placing aₙ last——非空时取归纳排列p'并在末尾放置aₙ
All prefix sums of first n-1 jumps are ≤ x and avoid M'——验证前n-1次跳跃的前缀和避开M'
the final sum is s ∉ M——验证最终前缀和（总和s）不在M中
Case 3条件: all m ∈ M satisfy m ≤ x——Case3的前提条件：M中所有元素都不超过x
Let z = max(M), M' = M\{z}——定义z为M的最大元，M'为去掉z后的缩减禁集
Apply induction to a₁,...,a_{n-1} with M' (|M'| = n-2), get permutation p'——对前n-1个元素和M'应用归纳假设得到排列p'
If some prefix sum of p' equals z at position k, swap position k with the last position——若p'的某前缀和恰好在位置k命中z，则将位置k与末位交换
place aₙ at position k (jumping over z since aₙ > a_{p'(k)})——将aₙ放在位置k，利用aₙ的最大性跳过z
and place a_{p'(k)} last——将被替换的元素a_{p'(k)}放到末位完成交换
If no prefix sum equals z, p' already avoids all of M (since M = M' ∪ {z} and z is never hit)——若没有前缀和命中z，则p'已经避开整个M
The general case (unsorted a) is reduced to the sorted case by composing with the sorting permutation——一般（未排序）情形通过复合排序置换归约到排序情形
